title: Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrids for Train-Once, Export-Many Budgeted Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.32486v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deploying a language model under different computing and latency budgets calls for compact models with different quality-cost trade-offs. Towards this end, elastic spectral state space models provide ordered and temporally decomposed channels that can be truncated, but they are associated with linear time-invariant filters that cannot selectively preserve relevant past information or forget irrelevant information as the context evolves. To address this, we introduce the Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrid (ESSH), which realizes each Hankel spectral channel as an independent recurrent unit using fitted damped rotation modes. It also features an input-dependent decay and write/read gates that make temporal retention and state update input-dependent while preserving channel-wise truncation and a structured recurrence for efficient execution. translated_title: 面向一次训练、多预算导出推理的弹性选择性谱混合模型
translated_abstract: 在不同的计算和延迟预算下部署语言模型，需要具有不同质量-成本权衡的紧凑模型。为此，弹性谱状态空间模型提供了有序且在时间上可分解的通道，可以被截断，但它们与线性时不变滤波器相关联，无法随着上下文的演变选择性地保留相关的历史信息或遗忘无关信息。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了弹性选择性谱混合模型（ESSH），它使用拟合的阻尼旋转模式将每个Hankel谱通道实现为独立的循环单元。它还具有依赖于输入的衰减和写入/读取门控，使时间信息保留和状态更新依赖于输入，同时保留了通道级截断能力和结构化循环以实现高效执行。ESSH将这些选择性谱混合器与滑动窗口注意力相结合，并联合训练多个……
tldr: 提出弹性选择性谱混合模型（ESSH），通过输入相关的衰减与门控机制赋予谱状态空间模型选择性记忆能力，并结合滑动窗口注意力，实现一次训练即可导出适配多种计算预算的高效语言模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Elastic Selective Spectral Hybrid (ESSH), which endows spectral state space models with selective memory via input-dependent decay and gating, combined with sliding-window attention, enabling train-once, export-many deployment across diverse compute budgets.
